media.title: Warsaw Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper’s Warsaw years. Includes archival documents, contextual Warsaw images, the 1925 Chopin Music School recital notice, a 1926 Perskie Oko performance photograph, and press items connected with his early musical activity and studies.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s Warsaw years, combining documents, press items and contextual images.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual images relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Warsaw years, including the 1925 Chopin Music School recital, university study, early songwriting traces and Zula Pogorzelska in the 1926 Perskie Oko revue “My chcemy króla.”
media.publicImageText: Document-gallery entry for the Warsaw Years section.

media.title: Zula Pogorzelska in My chcemy króla at Teatr Perskie Oko (1926)
media.description: Stage photograph of Zula Pogorzelska in a scene from the revue “My chcemy króla” at Warsaw’s Teatr “Perskie Oko,” April 1926. The photograph provides visual context for the interwar revue environment in which Kaper’s earliest Warsaw songs and professional networks developed; it is not used as evidence for a Kaper credit in this revue.
media.altText: Black-and-white stage photograph of Zula Pogorzelska posing with a folding fan in an ornate costume and large decorative hat.
media.rightsNote: Public domain according to the Szukaj w Archiwach object record. media.publicCaption: Zula Pogorzelska in a scene from “My chcemy króla” at Teatr “Perskie Oko,” Warsaw, April 1926. The photograph documents the visual culture of the Warsaw revue stage during Kaper’s early professional period.
